requirements.title: Portable text
requirements.statement: Tracked text uses UTF-8, LF and a final newline.
requirements.limitation: Does not assess prose meaning.
requirements.remediation: Normalize encoding and line endings.
requirements.exception_policy: No exceptions for first-party text.

requirements.title: Repository path integrity
requirements.statement: Tracked paths are case-unique and symlinks remain inside the repository.
requirements.limitation: Assumes the inspected Git index is authoritative.
requirements.remediation: Repair collisions, broken links or escaping links.
requirements.exception_policy: No exceptions.

requirements.title: Merge-marker rejection
requirements.statement: Tracked text contains no unresolved merge markers.
requirements.limitation: Marker-like fixture files require an explicit fixture scope.
requirements.remediation: Resolve the merge and retain the intended content.
requirements.exception_policy: Fixture paths may be narrowly excluded.

requirements.title: Classified formats
requirements.statement: Every tracked file format is classified or explicitly declared.
requirements.limitation: Classification does not validate domain semantics.
requirements.remediation: Enable a profile or declare the format with a local gate.
requirements.exception_policy: Declarations require a remediation owner.

requirements.title: Immutable Actions
requirements.statement: GitHub Actions references use complete commit SHAs.
requirements.limitation: A pinned action can still contain vulnerable code.
requirements.remediation: Pin the reviewed action revision to its full SHA.
requirements.exception_policy: Local actions are exempt; remote mutable refs are not.

requirements.title: Workflow trust boundaries
requirements.statement: Each workflow declares bounded event, runner, checkout, permission and publication trust transitions with finite fail-closed jobs.
requirements.limitation: Static inspection cannot prove hosted settings, runner isolation, branch protection or runtime grants.
requirements.remediation: Repair the named trust transition in the repository-owned workflow trust policy and workflow.
requirements.exception_policy: No unclassified event, runner, privilege, credential, expression or fail-open transition.

requirements.title: Valid workflow-local paths
requirements.statement: Paths referenced by GitHub workflow commands exist inside the repository.
requirements.limitation: Static token recognition does not interpret dynamically constructed paths.
requirements.remediation: Correct the reference or add the required tracked file.
requirements.exception_policy: Dynamic references require a narrow project-local gate.

requirements.title: Python syntax
requirements.statement: First-party Python files compile under the running supported interpreter.
requirements.limitation: Compilation is not typing, lint or runtime behavior evidence.
requirements.remediation: Repair syntax and rerun project-specific Python gates.
requirements.exception_policy: No exceptions for first-party Python.

requirements.title: Shell entry points
requirements.statement: Executable shell files have a shell shebang.
requirements.limitation: Does not replace ShellCheck, shfmt or Bats.
requirements.remediation: Add the correct shebang and executable mode or remove executable mode.
requirements.exception_policy: No exceptions for first-party executable shell.

requirements.title: Local documentation links
requirements.statement: Relative Markdown links resolve inside the repository.
requirements.limitation: External availability is a scheduled network check.
requirements.remediation: Repair the path or anchor target.
requirements.exception_policy: Generated external URLs may be scoped separately.

requirements.title: Parseable JSON
requirements.statement: Every tracked JSON document parses without duplicate structural ambiguity.
requirements.limitation: Parsing does not establish schema conformance.
requirements.remediation: Repair JSON and run its owning schema validator.
requirements.exception_policy: No exceptions.

requirements.title: Credential and private-path exclusion
requirements.statement: Tracked text excludes credential signatures and machine-private absolute paths.
requirements.limitation: Pattern scanning cannot prove absence of all sensitive data.
requirements.remediation: Remove the value, rotate credentials when needed and use synthetic fixtures.
requirements.exception_policy: Synthetic canaries must be isolated under declared fixture paths.

requirements.title: Pinned quality bundle
requirements.statement: The project lock binds profiles and requirements to an immutable registry digest.
requirements.limitation: The digest does not establish upstream trust by itself.
requirements.remediation: Run an explicit reviewed AWQ update from the intended release.
requirements.exception_policy: No floating bundle references.

requirements.title: Truthful formal evidence
requirements.statement: Formal-method documentation classifies bounds, assumptions and non-claims.
requirements.limitation: Text presence does not prove the model ran or refined implementation.
requirements.remediation: Document evidence class, finite bounds, assumptions and limitations.
requirements.exception_policy: No unclassified proof claims.

requirements.title: Locked Rust workspace
requirements.statement: A Rust project commits Cargo.lock.
requirements.limitation: A lockfile does not audit advisories or licenses.
requirements.remediation: Generate, review and commit Cargo.lock.
requirements.exception_policy: Library-only exceptions require an explicit project decision.

requirements.title: Verified Gradle dependencies
requirements.statement: Gradle projects commit dependency verification metadata.
requirements.limitation: Metadata does not prove dependency behavior is safe.
requirements.remediation: Review artifacts and regenerate strict SHA-256 verification metadata.
requirements.exception_policy: No unverified release dependency.

requirements.title: Canonical terminology
requirements.statement: Selected tracked text uses consumer-declared canonical vocabulary in each applicable lexical scope.
requirements.limitation: Lexical matching does not establish meaning, intent, translation quality, or complete natural-language interpretation.
requirements.remediation: Use the canonical label or add a narrow, reviewed, time-bounded terminology exception.
requirements.exception_policy: Exceptions bind one term to explicit paths and scopes for at most 90 days.

requirements.title: Typed oracle interaction gates
requirements.statement: Typed interaction-gate records bind task revision, context, before/after artifacts, passing formal review, user disposition and a public-safe projection.
requirements.limitation: A valid record proves only bounded quality-contract completeness; it does not establish user intent, implementation correctness, or the truth of the recorded disposition.
requirements.remediation: Add the missing typed interaction-gate evidence or keep the quality gate failed.
requirements.exception_policy: No exceptions for missing interaction, review, artifact digest, privacy projection, or unresolved status.

requirements.title: Discussion reconciliation consistency
requirements.statement: Completed discussion records bind symmetric before/after artifacts, affected-AR dispositions, current formal results, and distinct guidance, quality, and implementation outcomes.
requirements.limitation: A valid record proves only bounded reconciliation completeness; it does not prove user intent, implementation correctness, formal refinement, or replace consumer-native gates.
requirements.remediation: Add a current, public-safe reconciliation record with a refreshed formal result or keep the quality gate failed.
requirements.exception_policy: No exceptions for stale artifacts, stale formal results, unresolved affected ARs, missing limitations, or collapsed acceptance dimensions.

requirements.title: Contradiction and guidance resolution
requirements.statement: Ambiguous, contradictory, stale, or scope-changing guidance records an explicit bounded state transition and remains non-authorizing until a fresh discussion and formal review reconcile it.
requirements.limitation: A valid record proves only transition-shape completeness; it does not establish user intent, implementation correctness, formal refinement, or the truth of a disposition.
requirements.remediation: Record the explicit clarification, rejection, alternative, reconciliation, or reopen result with a fresh task revision and public-safe evidence.
requirements.exception_policy: No exceptions for unresolved guidance, stale responses, mismatched state/result pairs, unauthorized transitions, or private projections.

requirements.title: Batched proposal and implication quality
requirements.statement: Batched discussion points retain ranked evaluated proposals, concise implications, evidence limits, formal references, evaluated user alternatives, and independent revision-bound response authorization.
requirements.limitation: A valid record proves only bounded packet quality and binding shape; it does not establish user intent, implementation correctness, or formal refinement.
requirements.remediation: Add a complete public-safe batched discussion quality record or keep the quality gate failed.
requirements.exception_policy: No exceptions for missing proposal evaluation, implication limits, formal evidence, independent response binding, or cross-point authorization.

requirements.title: Cross-project oracle workflow integration
requirements.statement: A bounded synthetic trace proves that Coordinator task events, AWG decision semantics, and AWQ quality evidence remain ordered, revision-bound, and non-authorizing across the complete oracle workflow.
requirements.limitation: A valid trace proves only bounded public-contract composition; it does not prove user intent, implementation correctness, formal refinement, provider integration, or consumer-native gates.
requirements.remediation: Provide the complete public-safe trace with every mandatory stage and distinct AWG/AWQ evidence, or keep the quality gate failed.
requirements.exception_policy: No exceptions for skipped stages, stale revisions, unresolved guidance, quality-only authorization, or private projections.
